name: PicPay
description:
Integre a inteligência artificial diretamente ao core banking do PicPay.
Permita que seus agentes realizem operações, gerenciem cofrinhos e consultem saldos em tempo real, mantendo você sempre no controle com aprovação via celular.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PicPay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PicPay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.svc.picpay.com/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PicPay MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PicPay lists 13 MCP tools, including balance_account_get, bills_slips_list, cards_invoice_get, cards_invoice_summary_get, cards_invoice_transactions_list, cards_invoices_list, cards_list, investments_list, piggy_list, pix_contacts_list, pix_keys_list, and pix_limits_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PicPay?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PicPay in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
PicPay requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PicPay is developed by PicPay. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
